control: Fresh CPU/memory reset per run resets PCAT buffers; AT refresh disabled, owner refresh active. Bench instantiates the unmodified production generator with separately released reset and connects its boundary to the machine timing_cpu_boundary wire, which advances naturally for phase edges while CPU/memory remain in reset. execute_enable remains asserted; no RTL register is forced. Exact M0 kernel/location/data; 32 iterations for search, 256 for extrema confirmation.
